### Power Supply - LEADEX III GOLD ARGB / LEADEX III Gold ARGB 550W (BK)

##### Products Name : LEADEX III Gold ARGB 550W (BK)

 

### Features

LEADEX III ARGB series, which are based on LEADEX III platform, features RGB lighting. The Led RGB light possesses 16 light modes such as, Rainbow mode, Breathing mode, Blink mode, and single color mode etc..which can be controlled manually through the button. The RGB PSU could also be controlled through the motherboard from ASUS, Gigabyte or MSI with a 5V RGB header. LEADEX III ARGB series PSU provides high efficiency & stable power output and come with a 13cm two-way thermal control intelligent cooling fan to ensure your professional PC system will work under heavy load, also capable of powering your PC system equipped with NVIDIA® SLI™ or ATI CrossFireX™ setup.
